438: fn value_should_be_printed(
439:     value: &Value,
440:     filter_config: &Config,
441:     lower_terms: &[Value],
442:     span: Span,
443:     columns_to_search: &[String],
444:     invert: bool,

447:         value.to_expanded_string("", filter_config).to_lowercase(),
448:         span,
449:     );
450: 
451:     let mut match_found = lower_terms.iter().any(|term| match value {
452:         Value::Bool { .. }
453:         | Value::Int { .. }
454:         | Value::Filesize { .. }
455:         | Value::Duration { .. }
456:         | Value::Date { .. }
457:         | Value::Range { .. }
458:         | Value::Float { .. }
459:         | Value::Closure { .. }
460:         | Value::Nothing { .. }
461:         | Value::Error { .. } => term_equals_value(term, &lower_value, span),

463:         | Value::Glob { .. }
464:         | Value::List { .. }

466:         | Value::Custom { .. } => term_contains_value(term, &lower_value, span),

469:         }
470:         Value::Binary { .. } => false,
471:     });
472:     if invert {
473:         match_found = !match_found;
474:     }
475:     match_found
476: }

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the `ByteStream` branch of `find_with_rest_and_highlight` (crates/nu-command/src/filters/find.rs:419), where each line was lowercased via `line?.to_lowercase()` before being emitted. Since `highlight_search_string` already uses a case-insensitive regex (`(?i)`), I changed the branch to:

- keep the original line text for output,
- match terms case-insensitively using `to_folded_case()` on both line and term.

Verification:
- `"ABC" | save -f /tmp/foo.txt; open /tmp/foo.txt | find "ABC"` now outputs `ABC` (preserving case).
- `cargo test -p nu-command` : 381 lib tests + 1520 integration tests pass; the only 3 failures (`cd_permission_denied_folder`, `rm_prints_filenames_on_error`, `external_arg_expand_tilde`) also fail on the unmodified baseline (root-user environment issues, unrelated to this change).
